title: Martin Scorsese Says His ‘Cleopatra’ Movie With Angelina Jolie Was ‘Ruined’ by Seth Rogen and the Sony Hack: ‘It Was Gonna Be Really Wild’
content:
ByWilliam Earl

Martin Scorsese‘s “Cleopatra” never came to fruition, and he says theAngelina Jolie-starrer was nixed because ofSeth Rogenand the Sony hack.

For those who need a refresher, Sony emails were hacked in November 2014 by a group that hoped the Seth Rogen comedy “The Interview,” which was about a fictional assassination attempt of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, would not be released by Sony.

According to Scorsese, this caused some aftereffects in the industry, which he described in the first episode of the Tribeca original series “Crafty.”

“We were gonna do Cleopatra at one point, and then they made fun of [Kim Jong Un], and he got mad and blew up everybody at Columbia,” Scorsese said. “Seth Rogen, right? And then he got mad, and [it] ruined Cleopatra.”

Though Rogen wasn’t directly responsible for the project being canceled, the resulting hack exposed thousands of emails, includingones from producer Scott Rudinto Sony’s Amy Pascal calling Jolie “a minimally talented spoiled brat.”

“We were gonna do it,” Scorsese also said. “Angelina Jolie. We were going. She was gonna be Cleopatra VII. It was gonna be really wild.”

The film was set to be written by screenwriter Eric Roth, who wrote Scorsese’s 2023 film “Killers of the Flower Moon.”

Watch the episode of “Crafty” below.
title_zh: 馬丁·史高西斯(Martin Scorsese)表示，他與安吉麗娜·朱莉(Angelina Jolie)合作的《克利奧帕特拉》電影因塞斯·羅根(Seth Rogen)和索尼駭客事件而「被毀了」： 「這部電影本來會非常瘋狂」。
content_zh:
威廉·厄爾(By William Earl)

馬丁·史科西斯(Martin Scorsese)的《克利奧帕特拉(Cleopatra)》從未實現，他表示這部由安吉莉娜·朱莉(Angelina Jolie)主演的電影因塞斯·羅根(Seth Rogen)和索尼(Sony)的駭客事件而被取消。

對於需要回顧的人來說，2014年11月，一個駭客團體入侵了索尼的電子郵件，目的是希望塞斯·羅根的喜劇《訪問(The Interview)》，該片講述了對北韓領導人金正恩的虛構刺殺企圖，能夠不被索尼發行。

根據史科西斯的說法，這在業界造成了一些後果，他在特里貝卡(Tribeca)原創系列《工藝(Crafty)》的第一集中描述了這一情況。

“我們曾經打算拍《克利奧帕特拉》，然後他們取笑了金正恩，他生氣了，並摧毀了哥倫比亞影業(Columbia)的所有人，”史科西斯說。“是塞斯·羅根，對吧？然後他生氣了，這毀了《克利奧帕特拉》。”

雖然羅根並不是導致該項目被取消的直接原因，但隨之而來的駭客事件曝光了數千封電子郵件，包括製片人斯科特·魯丁(Scott Rudin)發給索尼的艾米·帕斯卡(Amy Pascal)的郵件，稱朱莉“是一個才華平平的被寵壞的小孩”。

“我們本來會拍的，”史科西斯還說。“安吉莉娜·朱莉。我們要開始了。她將會是克利奧帕特拉七世。這將會非常瘋狂。”

這部電影的劇本將由編劇埃裡克·羅斯(Eric Roth)撰寫，他曾為史科西斯的2023年電影《花月殺手(Killers of the Flower Moon)》寫劇本。
